functions.name: sqlite3_mutex_enter
functions.description: Enter (lock) a mutex; blocks until acquired. No-op if argument is NULL.
requirements: Must be paired with sqlite3_mutex_leave.
Recursive behavior depends on mutex type.

functions.name: sqlite3_mutex_try
functions.description: Attempt to enter mutex without blocking. Returns SQLITE_OK on success, SQLITE_BUSY if not entered. No-op if NULL (returns SQLITE_OK).
requirements: On some platforms try may always return SQLITE_BUSY for certain mutex impls with SETLK timeout feature.

functions.name: sqlite3_mutex_leave
functions.description: Exit (unlock) a mutex previously entered by the same thread. No-op if NULL.
requirements: Must be balanced with enter; undefined if not held by caller.

functions.name: sqlite3_mutex_held
functions.description: Debug/assert helper: return non-zero if mutex is held by caller. Only available in debug builds; otherwise may always return 1.
requirements: Should be used only in assert-like checks; returns 1 for NULL.

functions.name: sqlite3_mutex_notheld
functions.description: Debug/assert helper: return non-zero if mutex is not held by caller. Only in debug builds; returns 1 for NULL.

functions.name: sqlite3_db_mutex
functions.description: Return the mutex used to serialize connection db in serialized mode; NULL in single- or multi-thread modes.

functions.name: sqlite3_file_control
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_file_control(sqlite3 *db, const char *zDbName, int op, void *pArg);
functions.description: Invoke VFS xFileControl for open database zDbName ("main","temp", or attached) with opcode op and argument pArg. Some opcodes handled directly by core (e.g., FILE_POINTER, JOURNAL_POINTER, VFS_POINTER, DATA_VERSION).
requirements: zDbName must name an open database; otherwise returns SQLITE_ERROR (not stored in db error state).
Unrecognized opcodes should result in SQLITE_NOTFOUND from VFS.

functions.name: sqlite3_test_control
functions.description: Testing/diagnostic interface; not for applications. Various opcodes control internal behavior for test builds; subject to change without notice.
requirements: Do not use in production; undefined across versions.

functions.name: sqlite3_keyword_count
functions.description: Return number of SQL keywords recognized by SQLite.

functions.name: sqlite3_keyword_name
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_keyword_name(int N, const char **pzName, int *pnName);
functions.description: Write the N-th keyword name pointer and length (bytes, not NUL-terminated) into outputs; return SQLITE_OK on success, SQLITE_ERROR if out of range.
requirements: pzName and pnName must be non-NULL.
Returned pointer is managed by SQLite.

functions.name: sqlite3_keyword_check
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_keyword_check(const char *zName, int n);
functions.description: Return non-zero if the n-byte string zName is an SQL keyword, zero otherwise.
requirements: zName need not be NUL-terminated if n provided.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_new
functions.description: Create a dynamic string builder associated with db (limits/alloc). Always returns a valid object (may be an OOM singleton that rejects appends).

functions.description: Finalize builder X and return a malloced buffer containing the string (or NULL on OOM or zero-length). Caller must sqlite3_free() the result.
requirements: X must not be used after finish; it is destroyed.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_free
functions.description: Free a string builder and its content (equivalent to sqlite3_free(sqlite3_str_finish(X))). Safe for NULL.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_appendf
functions.description: Append formatted text to string builder X (SQLite printf dialect).
requirements: X must be a valid builder; ignores appends if in OOM state.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_vappendf
functions.signature: SQLITE_API void sqlite3_str_vappendf(sqlite3_str *X, const char *zFormat, va_list);
functions.description: va_list variant of sqlite3_str_appendf.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_append
functions.signature: SQLITE_API void sqlite3_str_append(sqlite3_str *X, const char *zIn, int N);
functions.description: Append exactly N bytes from zIn (or up to NUL if N<0) to builder X.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_appendall
functions.description: Append entire NUL-terminated string zIn to builder X.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_appendchar
functions.signature: SQLITE_API void sqlite3_str_appendchar(sqlite3_str *X, int N, char C);
functions.description: Append N copies of character C to builder X.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_reset
functions.description: Reset builder to empty, preserving allocation (unless in OOM).

functions.name: sqlite3_str_errcode
functions.description: Return SQLITE_OK if no errors occurred appending to X, SQLITE_NOMEM if builder is in OOM, SQLITE_TOOBIG if length exceeded limits.

functions.name: sqlite3_str_length
functions.description: Return current length (bytes, excluding terminator) of string in X.

functions.name: sqlite3_status
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_status(int op, int *pCurrent, int *pHighwater, int resetFlag);
functions.description: Global runtime status: write current and high-water values for parameter op; optionally reset high-water. Returns SQLITE_OK or error.
requirements: pCurrent/pHighwater may be NULL depending on op semantics.
Values undefined if too large for 32-bit.

functions.name: sqlite3_status64
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_status64(int op, sqlite3_int64 *pCurrent, sqlite3_int64 *pHighwater, int resetFlag);
functions.description: 64-bit variant of sqlite3_status.

functions.name: sqlite3_db_status
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_db_status(sqlite3 *db, int op, int *pCur, int *pHiwtr, int resetFlg);
functions.description: Per-connection status: write current and high-water values for op; optionally reset. Returns SQLITE_OK or error.

functions.name: sqlite3_db_status64
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_db_status64(sqlite3 *db, int op, sqlite3_int64 *pCur, sqlite3_int64 *pHi, int resetFlg);
functions.description: 64-bit variant of sqlite3_db_status.

functions.name: sqlite3_stmt_status
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_stmt_status(sqlite3_stmt *stmt, int op, int resetFlg);

functions.description: Retrieve predicted/measured scan metrics for plan element idx for stmt. Write result to pOut of appropriate type. Returns SQLITE_OK/ERROR if idx out of range.

pOut must point to appropriate type (int64/double/const char*/int).

functions.name: sqlite3_backup_pagecount

Deadlock detection: returns SQLITE_LOCKED if would cause deadlock.

functions.name: sqlite3_stricmp
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_stricmp(const char *a, const char *b);
functions.description: Case-insensitive strcmp-like compare of UTF-8 strings using SQLite’s identifier folding rules. Returns 0 if equal.

functions.name: sqlite3_strnicmp
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_strnicmp(const char *a, const char *b, int n);
functions.description: Case-insensitive comparison of up to n bytes.

functions.name: sqlite3_strglob
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_strglob(const char *zGlob, const char *zStr);
functions.description: GLOB pattern match of zStr against pattern zGlob. Returns 0 if matches, non-zero otherwise.

functions.name: sqlite3_strlike
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_strlike(const char *zPattern, const char *zStr, unsigned int cEsc);
functions.description: LIKE pattern match with escape character cEsc (0 for none). Returns 0 if matches, non-zero otherwise.
requirements: ASCII case-folding only; Unicode folding not applied.

functions.name: sqlite3_log
functions.signature: SQLITE_API void sqlite3_log(int iErrCode, const char *zFormat, ...);
functions.description: Write formatted message to global error log if configured via SQLITE_CONFIG_LOG. Not reentrant; avoid calling into SQLite from logger.
requirements: zFormat must not be NULL.
Logger must be threadsafe in multi-threaded apps.

functions.name: sqlite3_wal_hook
functions.description: Register a callback invoked after a commit to a WAL-mode database file. Returns previous pArg.
requirements: Callback may checkpoint or read/write db; invoked after commit and lock release.
Callback should return SQLITE_OK ordinarily.

functions.name: sqlite3_wal_autocheckpoint
functions.description: Configure connection db to auto-checkpoint WAL when it reaches N frames (PASSIVE). Pass ≤0 to disable. Returns SQLITE_OK.
requirements: Overrides previous wal_hook settings regarding autocheckpoint.

functions.name: sqlite3_wal_checkpoint
functions.description: Run a passive checkpoint on database zDb (or all if NULL/empty) for connection db. Returns SQLITE_OK/error.

functions.name: sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2(sqlite3 *db, const char *zDb, int eMode, int *pnLog, int *pnCkpt);
functions.description: Checkpoint WAL for zDb in given mode (NOOP, PASSIVE, FULL, RESTART, TRUNCATE). Optionally return frame counts in pnLog/pnCkpt. Returns SQLITE_OK/error.
requirements: May block based on mode; may return BUSY without invoking busy-handler for checkpoint lock; busy-handler used for writer lock.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_config
functions.description: From within xCreate/xConnect, configure virtual table interface options such as SQLITE_VTAB_CONSTRAINT_SUPPORT, SQLITE_VTAB_DIRECTONLY, SQLITE_VTAB_INNOCUOUS, SQLITE_VTAB_USES_ALL_SCHEMAS.
requirements: Must be called only during xCreate/xConnect; undefined otherwise.
op and subsequent args depend on option.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_on_conflict
functions.description: Within virtual table xUpdate, return the current ON CONFLICT mode (ROLLBACK, FAIL, ABORT, REPLACE, IGNORE).
requirements: Only valid within xUpdate; use to implement REPLACE semantics.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_nochange
functions.description: Within a virtual table xColumn, return non-zero if the column is being fetched as part of an UPDATE that does not change it (no-change optimization).
requirements: Meaningful only within xColumn called from xUpdate path.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_rhs_value
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_vtab_rhs_value(sqlite3_index_info *pInfo, int iCons, sqlite3_value **ppVal);
functions.description: Within xBestIndex, attempt to retrieve the right-hand side literal value of constraint pInfo->aConstraint[iCons]; returns SQLITE_OK and sets *ppVal if available, SQLITE_NOTFOUND if not, or error.
requirements: Must pass the same pInfo pointer as provided to xBestIndex.
ppVal is valid only during xBestIndex.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_collation
functions.description: Within xBestIndex, return the collation name relevant to constraint iCons on pInfo, if applicable.
requirements: Use only in xBestIndex; returns managed string.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_distinct
functions.description: Within xBestIndex, inform/learn DISTINCT/ORDER BY handling requirements (returns 0..3) regarding ordering and duplicate handling for setting orderByConsumed etc.
requirements: Only call in xBestIndex; abide by documented semantics for values 0..3.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_in
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_vtab_in(sqlite3_index_info *pInfo, int iCons, int bHandle);
functions.description: Within xBestIndex, query (bHandle=-1) if constraint iCons is an IN(...) that can be handled all-at-once; or request (bHandle 0/1) whether to handle all-at-once. Returns non-zero if IN can be processed all-at-once.
requirements: Must also set argvIndex>0 for the constraint if handling it; then xFilter sees a special sqlite3_value* for enumeration via vtab_in_first/next.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_in_first
functions.description: Within xFilter, for an IN(...) handled all-at-once, initialize iteration over RHS values. Sets *ppOut to first value and returns SQLITE_OK; returns SQLITE_DONE when exhausted.
requirements: pVal must be the special IN-argument sqlite3_value* passed to xFilter.
ppOut valid only until next call or end of xFilter.

functions.name: sqlite3_vtab_in_next
functions.description: Within xFilter, advance to next RHS value for an IN(...) constraint. Returns SQLITE_OK and sets *ppOut, or SQLITE_DONE when exhausted.
requirements: Same usage rules as vtab_in_first.

functions.name: sqlite3_system_errno
functions.description: Return underlying operating-system error code associated with the most recent I/O or open error on db.

functions.name: sqlite3_snapshot_get
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_snapshot_get(sqlite3 *db, const char *zSchema, sqlite3_snapshot **ppSnapshot);
functions.description: Create a snapshot object representing the current state of WAL-mode database schema zSchema on db. Opens a read transaction if needed. Returns SQLITE_OK and *ppSnapshot, or error.
requirements: db must not be in autocommit mode.
zSchema must be WAL-mode schema; else SQLITE_ERROR.
No write transaction may be open on schema.
At least one transaction must have been written to current WAL file.
Caller must free snapshot with sqlite3_snapshot_free().

functions.name: sqlite3_snapshot_open
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_snapshot_open(sqlite3 *db, const char *zSchema, sqlite3_snapshot *pSnapshot);
functions.description: Start or upgrade a read transaction on schema zSchema to use historical snapshot pSnapshot. Returns SQLITE_OK, or SQLITE_ERROR_SNAPSHOT if overwritten by checkpoint.
requirements: db must not be in autocommit mode and have no active statements if read tx exists.
Fails if db doesn’t know db is WAL (force via PRAGMA application_id).

functions.name: sqlite3_snapshot_free
functions.description: Destroy a snapshot object obtained from sqlite3_snapshot_get().
requirements: Safe to free only snapshots from sqlite3_snapshot_get().

functions.name: sqlite3_snapshot_cmp
functions.description: Compare two snapshots for the same database: negative if p1 older than p2, zero if equal, positive if newer. Undefined if not comparable per docs.
requirements: Only valid if both from same WAL file since last deletion.

functions.name: sqlite3_snapshot_recover
functions.description: Scan WAL file and make all valid snapshots available to sqlite3_snapshot_open() for schema zDb. Returns SQLITE_OK or error.
requirements: No read transaction may be open; schema must be in WAL mode.

functions.name: sqlite3_serialize
functions.signature: SQLITE_API unsigned char *sqlite3_serialize(sqlite3 *db, const char *zSchema, sqlite3_int64 *piSize, unsigned int mFlags);
functions.description: Return an allocated buffer containing a serialization of schema zSchema (absolute image). If SQLITE_SERIALIZE_NOCOPY set and contiguous representation exists, may return internal buffer pointer. *piSize set to size. Caller must sqlite3_free() unless NOCOPY case and no copy made.
requirements: If NOCOPY and no contiguous buffer exists, returns NULL but *piSize is set to size.
Returned buffer lifetime for NOCOPY: valid until next write on connection or close; must not be modified.

functions.name: sqlite3_deserialize
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_deserialize(sqlite3 *db, const char *zSchema, unsigned char *pData, sqlite3_int64 szDb, sqlite3_int64 szBuf, unsigned mFlags);
functions.description: Replace schema zSchema with in-memory database backed by buffer pData of size szBuf containing szDb bytes initialized image. Flags SQLITE_DESERIALIZE_FREEONCLOSE/RESIZEABLE/READONLY control behavior.
requirements: No read transaction or backup on schema; cannot deserialize TEMP.
Deserialized DB should not be in WAL mode (or adjust header format).
If error occurs and FREEONCLOSE set, pData is freed.

functions.name: sqlite3_carray_bind
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_carray_bind(sqlite3_stmt *pStmt, int i, void *aData, int nData, int mFlags, void (*xDel)(void*));
functions.description: Bind the first argument of the carray() table-valued function in statement pStmt at index i to an array aData of nData elements of type mFlags (SQLITE_CARRAY_*). Optional destructor xDel for aData.
requirements: pStmt must reference carray() function parameter at index i.
mFlags one of SQLITE_CARRAY_INT32/INT64/DOUBLE/TEXT/BLOB.
xDel called when SQLite finishes using the array.

functions.name: sqlite3_rtree_geometry_callback
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_rtree_geometry_callback(sqlite3 *db, const char *zGeom, int (*xGeom)(sqlite3_rtree_geometry*, int, sqlite3_rtree_dbl*, int*), void *pContext);
functions.description: Register a geometry function zGeom for use with R-Tree MATCH queries. xGeom invoked with parameters for testing node/entry intersection; pContext passed via sqlite3_rtree_geometry.pContext.
requirements: xGeom must set result int* argument indicating within/overlap per R* semantics.
Register on connections that will run queries.

functions.name: sqlite3_rtree_query_callback
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3_rtree_query_callback(sqlite3 *db, const char *zQueryFunc, int (*xQueryFunc)(sqlite3_rtree_query_info*), void *pContext, void (*xDestructor)(void*));
functions.description: Register a 2nd-gen R-Tree query callback zQueryFunc that can score/accept entries; pContext and optional xDestructor manage user data.
requirements: xQueryFunc must fill rScore/eWithin as appropriate and use query info fields per docs.

functions.name: sqlite3session_create
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3session_create(sqlite3 *db, const char *zDb, sqlite3_session **ppSession);
functions.description: Create a new session object attached to database handle db and schema zDb ("main"/"temp" etc.).
requirements: Returns SQLITE_OK and *ppSession on success; else error and *ppSession=NULL.
Do not register preupdate hook on db while session attached.

functions.name: sqlite3session_delete
functions.description: Delete a session object. Must be called before closing its database handle.

functions.name: sqlite3session_object_config
functions.description: Configure a session object: SQLITE_SESSION_OBJCONFIG_SIZE enables changeset_size tracking; SQLITE_SESSION_OBJCONFIG_ROWID enables rowid handling for PK-less tables.
requirements: Must be set before attaching first table; else SQLITE_MISUSE for some options.

functions.name: sqlite3session_enable
functions.description: Enable (>0), disable (0), or query (<0) whether session records changes. Returns final state 0/1.

functions.name: sqlite3session_indirect
functions.description: Set (>0), clear (0), or query (<0) the session indirect-change flag (marks recorded changes as indirect). Returns final state 0/1.

functions.name: sqlite3session_attach
functions.description: Attach table zTab to record changes. If zTab is NULL, record changes for all current and future tables. Ignored for tables without explicit PK.
requirements: Returns SQLITE_OK (even if table missing or without PK).

functions.name: sqlite3session_table_filter
functions.description: Install a filter callback invoked for unattached tables to decide whether to record changes (return non-zero to record).

functions.name: sqlite3session_changeset
functions.description: Generate a changeset for all attached tables based on accumulated records and current DB content. On success, *ppChangeset points to malloced buffer and *pnChangeset its size.
requirements: Caller must sqlite3_free(*ppChangeset).
May return SQLITE_OK with zero-length changeset equal even if changes recorded then reverted.

functions.name: sqlite3session_changeset_size
functions.description: If enabled via object_config SIZE, return an upper bound in bytes on changeset size that would be produced by sqlite3session_changeset(). Otherwise returns 0.

functions.name: sqlite3session_diff
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3session_diff(sqlite3_session *pSession, const char *zFromDb, const char *zTbl, char **pzErrMsg);
functions.description: Attach zTbl (if not already) and add to the session the differences between table in zFromDb and the attached schema table so that applying changes to zFromDb would make it match the target table.
requirements: zFromDb must be attached database with compatible schema; else SQLITE_SCHEMA.
On error, *pzErrMsg may be set to malloced string to be freed by caller.

functions.name: sqlite3session_patchset
functions.description: Generate a patchset (reduced changeset) from the session. Caller must sqlite3_free(*ppPatchset).

functions.name: sqlite3session_isempty
functions.description: Return non-zero if session has recorded no changes (even if changes later cancel out).

functions.name: sqlite3session_memory_used
functions.description: Return approximate heap memory usage by the session object.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_start
functions.description: Create an iterator over a changeset buffer. On success sets *pp; caller must finalize with sqlite3changeset_finalize().
requirements: pChangeset must remain valid until iterator finalized.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_start_v2
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_start_v2(sqlite3_changeset_iter **pp, int nChangeset, void *pChangeset, int flags);
functions.description: Like sqlite3changeset_start with flags (e.g., SQLITE_CHANGESETSTART_INVERT to iterate inverted changeset).

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_next
functions.description: Advance iterator to next change: returns SQLITE_ROW (valid), SQLITE_DONE (end), or error (e.g., SQLITE_CORRUPT).

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_op
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_op(sqlite3_changeset_iter *pIter, const char **pzTab, int *pnCol, int *pOp, int *pbIndirect);
functions.description: Fetch the current change operation type (INSERT/DELETE/UPDATE), table name, column count, and indirect flag. Returns SQLITE_OK or SQLITE_MISUSE if iterator invalid.
requirements: Must be on a valid change (after next() returns ROW). Outputs must be non-NULL.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_pk
functions.description: Return array of booleans indicating PK columns for the current table, and number of columns.
requirements: Requires SQLITE_ENABLE_SESSION.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_old
functions.description: For DELETE/UPDATE change, get the old.* value for column iVal. Returns SQLITE_OK and sets *ppValue, SQLITE_RANGE for out-of-range or misuse.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_new
functions.description: For INSERT/UPDATE change, get the new.* value for column iVal (may be NULL if UPDATE did not modify that column).

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_conflict
functions.description: Within conflict handler callbacks, fetch the value of column iVal from the conflicting row in the database.
requirements: Only valid within apply conflict handler for DATA/CONFLICT.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_fk_conflicts
functions.description: Within FOREIGN_KEY conflict handler, return total number of FK violations in destination DB via *pnOut.
requirements: Only valid for SQLITE_CHANGESET_FOREIGN_KEY callbacks.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_finalize
functions.description: Finalize and free a changeset iterator. Returns SQLITE_OK or error if any occurred during iteration.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_invert
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_invert(int nIn, const void *pIn, int *pnOut, void **ppOut);
functions.description: Produce an inverted changeset (INSERT↔DELETE, UPDATE swapped old/new). Caller must sqlite3_free(*ppOut).
requirements: Input must be valid changeset; otherwise SQLITE_CORRUPT.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_concat
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_concat(int nA, void *pA, int nB, void *pB, int *pnOut, void **ppOut);
functions.description: Concatenate two changesets A then B (equivalent to changegroup add A, add B, output).
requirements: Caller frees *ppOut.

functions.name: sqlite3_changegroup_new
functions.description: Create a new changegroup object for combining changesets or patchsets.
requirements: Caller must delete with sqlite3changegroup_delete().

functions.name: sqlite3changegroup_schema
functions.description: Optionally set a reference database schema to enforce table compatibility and fill default values when combining changes.
requirements: Must be called before adding incompatible changesets; returns SQLITE_SCHEMA on incompatibility.

functions.name: sqlite3changegroup_add
functions.description: Add a changeset or patchset to the group, merging per documented rules. Returns SQLITE_OK, SQLITE_SCHEMA (incompatible), SQLITE_CORRUPT, SQLITE_NOMEM.

functions.name: sqlite3changegroup_add_change
functions.description: Add the single current change from iterator to the group. Iterator must not be inverted; must be on a valid row.

functions.name: sqlite3changegroup_output
functions.description: Obtain a combined changeset/patchset from the changegroup. Caller frees *ppData.

functions.name: sqlite3changegroup_delete
functions.description: Delete a changegroup object.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_apply
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_apply(sqlite3 *db, int nChangeset, void *pChangeset, int (*xFilter)(void*,const char*), int (*xConflict)(void*,int,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), void *pCtx);
functions.description: Apply a changeset to connection db. Filter tables via xFilter; resolve conflicts via xConflict (must not be NULL). Encloses in a savepoint; returns SQLITE_OK or error.
requirements: xConflict must be provided and obey return value semantics (OMIT/REPLACE/ABORT).
Do not reenter same connection within callback in unsafe ways.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_apply_v2
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_apply_v2(sqlite3 *db, int nChangeset, void *pChangeset, int (*xFilter)(void*,const char*), int (*xConflict)(void*,int,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), void *pCtx, void **ppRebase, int *pnRebase, int flags);
functions.description: Like apply but can return rebase buffer (*ppRebase/*pnRebase) if conflicts, and supports flags (e.g. NOSAVEPOINT, INVERT, IGNORENOOP, FKNOACTION).
requirements: If *ppRebase set, caller must sqlite3_free().

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_apply_v3
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_apply_v3(sqlite3 *db, int nChangeset, void *pChangeset, int (*xFilter)(void*,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), int (*xConflict)(void*,int,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), void *pCtx, void **ppRebase, int *pnRebase, int flags);
functions.description: Like v2 but passes iterator to filter callback per change instead of table name.

functions.name: sqlite3_rebaser_create
functions.description: Create a rebaser object to rebase local changesets after applying remote ones.

functions.name: sqlite3rebaser_configure
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3rebaser_configure(sqlite3_rebaser *p, int nRebase, const void *pRebase);
functions.description: Configure rebaser with rebase buffer captured from apply_v2(). Can be called multiple times in order applied.

functions.name: sqlite3rebaser_rebase
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3rebaser_rebase(sqlite3_rebaser *p, int nIn, const void *pIn, int *pnOut, void **ppOut);
functions.description: Rebase a local changeset pIn using configured rebase info into *ppOut/*pnOut. Caller frees *ppOut.

functions.name: sqlite3rebaser_delete
functions.description: Delete a rebaser object.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_apply_strm
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_apply_strm(sqlite3 *db, int (*xInput)(void*,void*,int*), void *pIn, int (*xFilter)(void*,const char*), int (*xConflict)(void*,int,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), void *pCtx);
functions.description: Streaming variant of sqlite3changeset_apply; reads input via xInput callback.
requirements: xInput supplies chunks until *pnData=0.
Other callback requirements same as non-streaming.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_apply_v2_strm
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_apply_v2_strm(sqlite3 *db, int (*xInput)(void*,void*,int*), void *pIn, int (*xFilter)(void*,const char*), int (*xConflict)(void*,int,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), void *pCtx, void **ppRebase, int *pnRebase, int flags);
functions.description: Streaming variant of apply_v2.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_apply_v3_strm
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_apply_v3_strm(sqlite3 *db, int (*xInput)(void*,void*,int*), void *pIn, int (*xFilter)(void*,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), int (*xConflict)(void*,int,sqlite3_changeset_iter*), void *pCtx, void **ppRebase, int *pnRebase, int flags);
functions.description: Streaming variant of apply_v3.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_concat_strm
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_concat_strm(int (*xInputA)(void*,void*,int*), void *pInA, int (*xInputB)(void*,void*,int*), void *pInB, int (*xOutput)(void*,const void*,int), void *pOut);
functions.description: Streaming variant of changeset concatenation.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_invert_strm
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_invert_strm(int (*xInput)(void*,void*,int*), void *pIn, int (*xOutput)(void*,const void*,int), void *pOut);
functions.description: Streaming variant of changeset invert.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_start_strm
functions.description: Streaming variant of changeset_start.

functions.name: sqlite3changeset_start_v2_strm
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3changeset_start_v2_strm(sqlite3_changeset_iter **pp, int (*xInput)(void*,void*,int*), void *pIn, int flags);
functions.description: Streaming variant of changeset_start_v2.

functions.name: sqlite3session_changeset_strm
functions.description: Streaming variant of session_changeset (write to xOutput).

functions.name: sqlite3session_patchset_strm
functions.description: Streaming variant of session_patchset.

functions.name: sqlite3changegroup_add_strm
functions.description: Streaming variant of changegroup_add.

functions.name: sqlite3changegroup_output_strm
functions.description: Streaming variant of changegroup_output.

functions.name: sqlite3rebaser_rebase_strm
functions.signature: SQLITE_API int sqlite3rebaser_rebase_strm(sqlite3_rebaser *pRebaser, int (*xInput)(void*,void*,int*), void *pIn, int (*xOutput)(void*,const void*,int), void *pOut);
functions.description: Streaming variant of rebaser_rebase.

functions.description: Configure global session module parameters. Currently supports SQLITE_SESSION_CONFIG_STRMSIZE to set/get streaming chunk size via *(int*)pArg.
requirements: Must be called before creating any session objects and not concurrently; not threadsafe.
Returns SQLITE_OK or error.
